heading: Education and outreach
lead: The WTC Program Administrator shall institute a program that provides education and outreach on the existence and availability of services under the WTC Program. The outreach and education program—

children.text: the establishment of a public Web site with information about the WTC Program;
development and dissemination of outreach materials informing people about the program; and
the establishment of phone information services; and

tree.text: shall be conducted in a manner intended—

children.text: to reach all affected populations; and
to include materials for culturally and linguistically diverse populations.

sourceCredit: (July 1, 1944, ch. 373, title XXXIII, § 3303, as added Pub. L. 111–347, title I, § 101, Jan. 2, 2011, 124 Stat. 3629.)
